title: Free IT & Career Tools — Salary Estimator, Career Quiz & Training Matcher | techcadd Lucknow
metaDescription: Free career tools and IT calculators by techcadd Lucknow: Calculate fresher and experienced tech salaries, find your ideal software career track with our 4-question quiz, match 6 weeks / 6 months industrial training tracks, and access technical cheat sheets.

hero.text: Make confident career choices with our interactive diagnostics, market salary calculators, university training track matchers, AI interview simulators, and curated technical study hubs.

logic: Static hub page; no interactive logic. Cards link to each tool.

sections.heading: Choose a Free Career Tool to Begin
sections.text: Designed for college students, fresh graduates, and working professionals planning their next transition.

cards.title: Salary & Career Growth Estimator
cards.text: Compare fresher (0-1 yr) and 2-year packages for Full Stack, Python AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, and CAD across Lucknow, Delhi NCR, and remote roles.
bullets: Lucknow vs. NCR vs. Remote delta

cards.title: Find My Career Track Quiz
cards.text: Answer 4 quick diagnostic questions to find the ideal career track tailored to your interests, logic skills, and engineering branch, complete with a free personalized 90-day learning roadmap.

cards.title: 6 Weeks & 6 Months Training Matcher
cards.text: Select your university (PTU, PU, Chitkara, CU, CU HP), engineering branch, and semester to discover your officially approved industrial training track, seat availability, and syllabus.

cards.title: AI-Powered Mock Interview Prep
cards.text: Practice full-length technical, coding, and behavioral interview simulations with real-time AI evaluation, code-based questions from your GitHub, and ATS resume audits.
bullets: AI questions generated from YOUR code
Instant ATS resume audit & fix tips

cards.title: CGPA to Percentage Calculator
cards.text: Convert 10-point CGPA or semester SGPAs using official PTU (IKGPTU), Panjab University, CBSE, AICTE, and Chitkara formulas with placement eligibility checks.

cards.title: AI Cold Email & LinkedIn DM Generator
cards.text: Generate high-response cold emails, follow-up templates, and 300-character LinkedIn connection notes tailored for tech internships, fresher roles, and referral requests.
bullets: Cold email with subject line & follow-up

sections.heading: Free Study Guides & Student Portals
sections.text: Authoritative repositories of learning material, interview prep, student portfolios, and certificate validation.

cards.title: Free Study Materials & Cheat Sheets
cards.text: Download high-yield technical quick references for React 19, Next.js, Python, RAG architectures, Docker, Linux, and CAD shortcut blueprints.

cards.title: Tech Interview Q&A Hub (100+ Topics)
cards.text: Frequently asked technical and HR interview questions for freshers & junior developers across MERN, Python, Data Science, Cyber Security, and Cloud.

cards.title: Student Capstone Portfolio Showcase
cards.text: Inspect production-ready capstone applications built by techcadd students, featuring system architectures, live demo links, and GitHub repositories.

cards.title: Online Certificate Verification Portal
cards.text: Instant background check and credential validation portal for corporate recruiters, HR personnel, and universities to verify ISO 9001:2015 certificates.

cards.title: Find my career track
cards.text: Four questions, then a matching course and a 90-day roadmap — development, AI, cyber, marketing, CAD or core programming.

cards.title: AI Mock Interview Prep
cards.text: Practice real-time technical and behavioral interview questions with AI voice simulations, scoring metrics, and personalized feedback.

cards.title: CGPA to Percentage Calculator
cards.text: Instant university formula converter supporting PTU, Panjab University, CBSE, and Chitkara with placement eligibility check.
